The University of Lynchburg invites applications for an innovative, future-focused leader to serve as **Department Chair and Tenure-Track Associate or Full Professor of Computer Science** beginning in the 2027-28 academic year. As the tech sector undergoes a paradigm shift toward integrated intelligence, the era of the isolated syntax specialist is giving way to the age of system designers, AI architects, and ethical technology leaders. The University of Lynchburg seeks a visionary educator-scholar who will lead our Computer Science program away from language-centric coding and toward a human-centered, interdisciplinary model rooted in the liberal arts.
<br><br>
The typical full-time faculty teaching load is 12 contact hours per semester, reduced for this role to accommodate departmental leadership and administrative responsibilities.
<br> <br>
🗓️ Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Review of applications begins ***October 15, 2026*** and will continue until the position is filled.
